title: Bhole Baba Ice And Cold Storage Pvt. Ltd. v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J.; Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed following companion order; para 4.20 additional-security challenge failed.
headnote: A writ challenging demand of additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was connected with the Vehina Steels batch and, after an interim restraint on such demand, dismissed by the Division Bench following the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.
facts: Bhole Baba Ice and Cold Storage Pvt. Ltd. and four others challenged the distribution licensee's demand of additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 4 September 2013 the writ was connected with the Vehina Steels batch (W.P. No. 30582 of 2009) and similar matters, and the respondents were restrained from demanding additional security until further orders. On 21 March 2017 a later Division Bench dismissed the petition, pointing to the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.

holding_units.holding: The writ petition challenging demand of additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was dismissed, following the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.
